ALP_CANALS.desc: The 'Venice of the East' in a day: a shikara through Kuttanad's canals, Mullakkal's temple street, old canal-side warehouses, the 1862 lighthouse and the old pier.
ALP_CANALS.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Hotel pickups in town)
9:00 AM — Mullakkal temple street: The town's busy temple and market street. (Modest dress · temple rules apply)
9:45 AM — Shikara through Kuttanad: About 3 hours over Punnamada lake into village canals and paddy fields. (Boat paid direct)
1:00 PM — Lunch & the old canals: Karimeen lunch (own expense), then old warehouses on the Vadai canal.
3:00 PM — Alappuzha lighthouse: The 1862 lighthouse — climb up for views over the town and coast. (Tower: check timings)
4:15 PM — Alappuzha beach & old pier: The long beach and the ruins of the 150-year-old pier. (No swimming here)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_CANALS.gtk:
🛶 The boat ride: Shikaras are run by licensed operators near Finishing Point; the fare is paid direct to the operator. Life jackets for everyone; children always with an adult.
🗓️ Timings: The lighthouse tower usually opens in the morning and afternoon and may close on Mondays — then we see it from outside. Temples follow their own rules on dress and entry; we see them from outside if needed.
🌊 Beach safety: No swimming at Alappuzha beach — strong currents and old pier piles under the water. Paddle only at the edge, and never in the monsoon months.
🏨 Staying out of town?: We pick up from hotels and houseboat jetties in Alappuzha town. Staying at a resort further out? Ask us — a short extra drive may apply.
ALP_CANALS.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
ALP_CANALS.exc: Shikara fare (paid direct); Lunch and lighthouse entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
ALP_CANALS.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Light cotton clothes; Cash for the boat and snacks; Clothes covering shoulders and knees

ALP_KUTTANAD.desc: Into Kerala's rice bowl, where paddy grows below sea level: dyke roads through Kuttanad, an ancient basilica on the snake-boat river, Edathua's Gothic church and Thakazhi's home.
ALP_KUTTANAD.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Hotel pickups in town)
8:45 AM — Paddy below sea level: Mankombu's fields, farmed up to 2 m below sea level behind mud dykes. (Photo stop)
9:30 AM — Champakulam basilica: St Mary's, by tradition from AD 427, on the river of the Moolam snake-boat race. (Modest dress)
11:15 AM — Edathua St George's church: A tall Gothic church on the Pampa, a famous pilgrim centre. (Modest dress)
12:30 PM — Kuttanadan lunch: Duck roast, karimeen and Kerala meals at a village restaurant, own expense.
2:00 PM — Thakazhi museum: Home of Thakazhi Sivasankara Pillai, author of Chemmeen. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
4:30 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_KUTTANAD.gtk:
🌾 Kuttanad: Kuttanad's below-sea-level farming is a UN FAO-recognised heritage system — paddy behind dykes, canals above the fields. Roads run on narrow dykes; we stop only at safe spots for photos.
⛪ Churches: Shoulders and knees covered; quiet during mass and prayers. On feast days and Sundays the churches are crowded — we keep the visit short.
🗓️ Mondays & rain: The Thakazhi museum is closed on Mondays — then we add time at Champakulam and the river bank. In heavy rain Kuttanad roads can flood; we change the route if needed.
🏨 Staying out of town?: We pick up from hotels and houseboat jetties in Alappuzha town. Staying at a resort further out? Ask us — a short extra drive may apply.
ALP_KUTTANAD.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
ALP_KUTTANAD.exc: Lunch; Museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
ALP_KUTTANAD.carry: Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Umbrella in the rains; Insect repellent

ALP_KRISHNAPURAM.desc: Ambalappuzha's Krishna temple, the black-granite Karumadi Buddha and Krishnapuram Palace's giant mural, then home along the coast.
ALP_KRISHNAPURAM.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
7:30 AM — Ambalappuzha Sri Krishna temple: Home of the famous palpayasam; breakfast nearby, own expense. (Temple dress code)
9:00 AM — Karumadi Kuttan: A centuries-old black-granite Buddha in a small shrine near Ambalappuzha.
10:30 AM — Krishnapuram Palace: 18th-century palace with the huge Gajendra Moksham mural; lunch after. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
2:00 PM — Valiyazheekal lighthouse: A 41 m lighthouse and the arch bridge over the estuary. (Tower: check timings)
3:45 PM — Thottappally: Where Kuttanad's rivers meet the sea: spillway and beach. (No swimming)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_KRISHNAPURAM.gtk:
🛕 Temple visit: Men enter bare-chested in a mundu or dhoti; women in a saree, churidar or long skirt. Entry inside follows temple rules — guests who don't enter can see the temple pond and gateway.
🗓️ Closing days: Krishnapuram Palace is closed on Mondays and some public holidays — we don't run this tour on Mondays. Temple timings change on festival days; we re-confirm before your trip.
🌊 Beach safety: No swimming at Valiyazheekal or Thottappally — river mouths with strong currents. Stay off the breakwater rocks when waves are high.
🏨 Staying out of town?: We pick up from hotels and houseboat jetties in Alappuzha town. Staying at a resort further out? Ask us — a short extra drive may apply.
ALP_KRISHNAPURAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
ALP_KRISHNAPURAM.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Palace and lighthouse entry, temple offerings; Tolls and parking (private trips)
ALP_KRISHNAPURAM.carry: Mundu / dhoti or saree for the temple; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry and offerings; Comfortable sandals

ALP_MARARI.desc: North up the coast from Alappuzha: palm-lined Marari beach, Arthunkal's Portuguese-era basilica and fishing beach, then the Thanneermukkom bund across Vembanad lake.
ALP_MARARI.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Hotel pickups in town)
8:45 AM — Marari beach: A quiet, palm-lined fishing-village beach, best in the morning. (Swim only at lifeguard flags)
10:45 AM — Arthunkal basilica & beach: St Andrew's Basilica (rebuilt 1584) and the fishing beach beside it. (Modest dress)
12:30 PM — Lunch in Cherthala: Kerala meals or seafood at a town restaurant, own expense.
2:00 PM — Thanneermukkom bund: The great salt-water barrier across Vembanad lake: wide views, fishing canoes.
3:30 PM — Muhamma lakeside: The lake shore drive back, with views to Pathiramanal island. (Photo stop)
5:00 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_MARARI.gtk:
🌊 Beach safety: At Marari, swim only near the lifeguards and where flags allow — never at red flags. No sea bathing at Arthunkal or anywhere in the monsoon months.
⛪ Arthunkal: Shoulders and knees covered inside the basilica; quiet during mass. The January feast brings huge crowds — on those days we keep the stop short.
🌞 Sun & sand: Little shade on the beaches — bring a hat, sunscreen and water. Carry a change of clothes if you plan to get wet at Marari.
🏨 Staying out of town?: Staying at a Marari resort? We can pick you up there on the way. Hotels and houseboat jetties in Alappuzha town are included.
ALP_MARARI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
ALP_MARARI.exc: Lunch; Any boat rides (paid direct); Tolls and parking (private trips)
ALP_MARARI.carry: Swimwear and a change of clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Sandals for the sand

ALP_KOCHI.desc: Five centuries of Kochi in a day from Alappuzha: Chinese fishing nets, India's oldest European church, a Dutch palace of murals, Jew Town and Marine Drive.
ALP_KOCHI.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
9:30 AM — Fort Kochi: fishing nets & churches: Chinese fishing nets, St Francis Church (Vasco da Gama's first grave) and Santa Cruz Basilica. (Modest dress in the churches)
11:15 AM — Mattancherry Palace: The 'Dutch Palace' with its Ramayana murals and royal portraits. (Closed Fridays · entry own expense)
12:00 PM — Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue: Antique shops, spice stores and the 1568 synagogue. Lunch here, own expense. (Synagogue closed Fri & Sat)
2:30 PM — Kerala Folklore Museum: Masks, costumes and carved wooden halls from across South India. (Entry own expense)
4:00 PM — Marine Drive: A walk on the backwater promenade before the drive home.
6:45 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_KOCHI.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Mattancherry Palace is closed on Fridays; the synagogue on Fridays, Saturdays and Jewish holidays. On those days we swap in the Hill Palace Museum at Tripunithura — same price.
👗 What to wear: Shoulders and knees covered for the churches, synagogue and palace. No photos inside the synagogue or the palace galleries.
🚶 Walking: Fort Kochi and Jew Town are best on foot — about 3–4 km of easy walking in all. Wear comfortable shoes; lanes are uneven in places.
🚐 The drive: About 1 hr 45 min each way on NH 66 via Cherthala and Aroor. Evening traffic at Vyttila and Kundannoor can make the drop a little later.
ALP_KOCHI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
ALP_KOCHI.exc: Lunch; Palace, synagogue and museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
ALP_KOCHI.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

ALP_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? We pick you up at your door, hotel or houseboat jetty in Alappuzha and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you back.
ALP_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~85 km on NH 66 & NH 544: About 2–2.5 hours via Cherthala, Aroor, Vyttila, Edappally and Aluva — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
ALP_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave Alappuzha about 5.5 hours before an international flight and 4.5 hours before a domestic one. Vyttila and Edappally jam at 8–10 AM and 5–8 PM — allow extra time.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Arriving in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We can drop you straight at your hotel or houseboat jetty.
ALP_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
ALP_COK.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
ALP_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

ALP_TRV.desc: Flying out of Trivandrum? Start at your door, hotel or houseboat jetty in Alappuzha and step out at the right terminal — or land in Trivandrum and we drive you back to Alappuzha.
ALP_TRV.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~155 km on NH 66: About 4–4.5 hours via Haripad, Kayamkulam and Kollam, with a refreshment break on the way.
Drop-off — Trivandrum International Airport: T1 domestic or T2 international (Chakkai). Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
ALP_TRV.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave Alappuzha at least 7 hours before an international flight and 6 hours before a domestic one. NH 66 works and town traffic can add time.
🛫 Two terminals: T1 (domestic) and T2 (international, Chakkai) are on opposite sides of the runway. Check your ticket and tell us the terminal.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Trivandrum?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at arrivals. We can drop you straight at your hotel or houseboat jetty.
ALP_TRV.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
ALP_TRV.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
ALP_TRV.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T2) noted; A light snack for the drive

ALP_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates as far as you can see and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station, about five hours from Alappuzha.
ALP_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station; about 175 km via Aroor and Kothamangalam, roughly 5–5.5 hours.
Day 1 · 10:00 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · afternoon — Tea Museum: Lunch in Munnar town, then how tea goes from leaf to cup at Nullatanni. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · evening — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · ~7 PM — Drive home: Leave after lunch; back at your door in Alappuzha by evening.
ALP_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we go to Top Station instead.
🍃 Tea & spices: Tea estates are private land — photograph from the roadside. Spice gardens at Pallivasal and Kallar are optional, paid direct.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. In heavy-rain alerts hill roads can close at night — we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
ALP_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
ALP_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
ALP_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

ALP_THEKKADY.desc: Walk a cardamom and pepper plantation, catch a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show, and take the morning boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve — about 4–5 hours from Alappuzha.
ALP_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station; about 140 km via Changanassery and the Kuttikkanam ghat, roughly 4–5 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Spice plantation tour: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art at a Kumily theatre. Overnight in Thekkady. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Periyar Lake boat cruise: The first sailing — the best time to see elephants, gaur and deer at the water's edge. (Limited seats · tickets in advance)
Day 2 · late morning — Chellarkovil viewpoint: A cliff-edge view over the Cumbum valley and Tamil Nadu plains.
Day 2 · ~6:30 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat after lunch; back at your door in Alappuzha by evening.
ALP_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Only a few sailings a day with limited seats — we help you book tickets in advance. Animal sightings are never guaranteed; boats stop in storms.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or fixed-price shops in Kumily. Leeches on plantation paths in the wet season — wear socks.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or on Thekkady Road. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The drive: Ghat road after Mundakayam — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. The AC Road through Kuttanad can flood in heavy rain; we reroute if needed.
ALP_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
ALP_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
ALP_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

ALP_VAGAMON.desc: A long private day in Kerala's quiet hills: misty pine forest, rolling green meadows, the Kurisumala skyline and late-afternoon views from Thangalpara, about 3½ hours from Alappuzha.
ALP_VAGAMON.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station. Breakfast at Pala.
9:30 AM — Pine forest: Walk under tall pines on the slopes just outside Vagamon town. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Vagamon meadows & lake: Rolling grass hills with the Kurisumala view, then the calm lake ringed by tea. Lunch in town.
2:00 PM — Adventure park, Kolahalamedu: Paragliding in season and the glass bridge, when open. (Paid direct · operators confirm)
4:00 PM — Thangalpara: Hilltop rocks and a shrine with sweeping views over the valleys. (Easy uphill walk)
9:00 PM — Drop-off: Down via Erattupetta, Pala and Kottayam, back to your door in Alappuzha.
ALP_VAGAMON.gtk:
🪂 Paragliding & glass bridge: Paragliding runs in season and only when the weather allows; pay the operator directly. The glass bridge has been closed for repairs — we confirm if it's open before your trip.
🌧️ Weather: Mist rolls in most afternoons; grass slopes are slippery after rain. Best from September to May; heavy-rain alerts can close viewpoints.
⏱️ A long day: About 3½ hours each way via Kottayam and Pala, the last hour on hill roads. Prefer a slower pace? Ask us for a 2-day trip with a night in Vagamon.
👟 Walking: Meadows, pine forest and Thangalpara involve short uphill walks. Elderly guests can enjoy most views close to the road.
ALP_VAGAMON.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All Vagamon sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
ALP_VAGAMON.exc: Meals; Entry, paragliding and park tickets; Tolls and parking
ALP_VAGAMON.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes with grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for entry fees

ALP_VARKALA.desc: Red laterite cliffs over the Arabian Sea, the old Janardana Swamy temple, Sree Narayana Guru's Sivagiri and a quiet sunset at Kappil, where the backwater meets the sea.
ALP_VARKALA.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station. Breakfast at Kayamkulam on NH 66.
9:45 AM — Varkala Cliff & Papanasam Beach: Cliff-top walk from the Helipad, then the steps down to the beach — strong currents. (Swim only at flagged spots)
11:30 AM — Janardana Swamy Temple: The ancient Vishnu temple above Papanasam. Lunch at the cliff-top cafés after. (Dress code · Hindus only inside)
2:00 PM — Sivagiri Mutt: The ashram and resting place of the reformer Sree Narayana Guru. (Footwear off · quiet)
4:00 PM — Kappil beach & lake: Where the backwater meets the sea: an optional boat ride, then sunset on the sand bar. (Boating paid direct · no swimming)
9:00 PM — Drop-off: Along the coast to Kollam, then NH 66 home to Alappuzha.
ALP_VARKALA.gtk:
🌊 Sea safety: Papanasam has strong currents — swim only between the lifeguard flags; no sea bathing June–September. Kappil's sea is rough: no swimming there at all — boating on the lake only.
🛕 Temple & ashram: Janardana Swamy: modest dress; only Hindus enter the inner temple. Sivagiri: footwear off, shoulders and knees covered, silence near the samadhi.
🧗 On the cliff: The laterite edge crumbles — stay behind railings, no selfies at the edge. Paragliding runs in season with licensed operators only, paid direct.
⏱️ A long day: About 3 hours each way on NH 66, where widening work slows traffic. Prefer a slower pace? Ask us to add a night in Varkala.
ALP_VARKALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All Varkala sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
ALP_VARKALA.exc: Meals; Boating, activities and offerings; Tolls and parking
ALP_VARKALA.carry: Swimwear and towel; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for boating and cafés

ALP_SABARIMALA.desc: Your own vehicle from Alappuzha to Nilakkal base camp for the 2026-27 Mandala–Makaravilakku season, with an Erumely stop if you wish — the driver waits to bring you home.
ALP_SABARIMALA.itin:
≈4:30 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, houseboat jetty or Alappuzha station. (Example: 10 AM slot)
On the road — Via Changanassery & Karukachal: About 110 km to Nilakkal through rubber country, with a tea break.
≈6:15 AM — Erumely (optional): Petta Thullal at the Petta Sastha temple and a visit to Vavar Palli. (Tell us when booking)
≈8:30 AM — Nilakkal base camp: Private vehicles stop here; KSRTC chain buses take you on to Pampa. (Bus fare paid direct)
Day — Pampa, the climb & darshan: About 5 km uphill on foot to Sannidhanam, darshan, and the walk back. (Virtual Queue booked by you)
≈11 PM — Home: Your driver waits at Nilakkal and brings you home the same night.
ALP_SABARIMALA.gtk:
📱 Virtual Queue: Book your darshan slot yourself at sabarimalaonline.org; carry the QR coupon and the same photo ID. Spot-booking counters are limited — don't count on them.
🅿️ Nilakkal & Pampa: Private vehicles are not allowed to Pampa — KSRTC chain buses run from Nilakkal. Save your driver's number and the parking block.
🗓️ Season 2026-27: The temple opens on 16 Nov 2026; Mandala Pooja is on 27 Dec; Makaravilakku in mid-January 2027. Peak days bring police holds and long queues — we re-confirm before you travel.
❤️ The climb: About 5 km of steep forest path — go slow; medical centres with oxygen line the route. Elderly pilgrims and heart patients: check with your doctor first.
ALP_SABARIMALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Erumely stop on request; Driver bata; No waiting charges at Nilakkal
ALP_SABARIMALA.exc: KSRTC Nilakkal–Pampa bus; Meals and offerings; Virtual Queue booking (done by you); Tolls and parking
ALP_SABARIMALA.carry: QR coupon and photo ID; Irumudi kettu; Torch and a warm layer; Your medicines and water

ALP_KANYAKUMARI.desc: India's southern tip: the wooden palace of the Travancore kings, a sunset and a sunrise where three seas meet, and a ferry to Vivekananda Rock and the Thiruvalluvar statue.
ALP_KANYAKUMARI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door in Alappuzha. About 250 km on NH 66 via Kollam and Trivandrum, 6–7 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 2:00 PM — Padmanabhapuram Palace: The Travancore kings' carved wooden palace at Thuckalay, after lunch on the way. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · evening — Sunset at Kanyakumari: Watch the sun go down at the tip of India. Overnight in Kanyakumari. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · ~6 AM — Sunrise over three seas: The famous sunrise from the shore by the temple.
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Vivekananda Rock & Thiruvalluvar statue: Government ferry to the rock memorial; a glass bridge links it to the statue. (Ferry paid direct · go early)
Day 2 · late morning — Kumari Amman Temple: The ancient shore temple of the virgin goddess. (Men remove shirts · dress code)
Day 2 · ~8:30 PM — Home: About 255 km back to Alappuzha — Suchindram temple on the way if you wish.
ALP_KANYAKUMARI.gtk:
🛂 Tamil Nadu entry: Kanyakumari is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We arrange the permit before your trip.
⛴️ The Rock ferry: Government ferries run from about 8 AM to 4 PM; queues grow after 9 — go early. Tickets paid direct; ferries pause when the sea is rough.
🛕 Palace & temple: Padmanabhapuram Palace is closed on Mondays — on a Monday we visit Suchindram instead. Kumari Amman: men remove shirts; modest dress for all.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; sea-view rooms near the sunrise point fill fast. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
ALP_KANYAKUMARI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Palace, sunset & temple drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
ALP_KANYAKUMARI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Ferry, palace and temple tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
ALP_KANYAKUMARI.carry: Photo ID; Modest temple clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for ferry and entry

ALP_VELANKANNI.desc: From Alappuzha over the Kumily ghat to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church, candle prayers and the shore.
ALP_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 5:00 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Via Kumily, Theni and Trichy, ghats in daylight; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Mass, Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross path. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · late morning — Morning Star Church & museum: The upper church and the museum of offerings; lunch own expense.
Day 2 · evening — Candle prayers & the shore: A rest after lunch; evening rosary and candles at the shrine, sunset on the beach. (No swimming)
Day 3 · ~6:30 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty (We leave at 5 AM)
ALP_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: About 13 hours each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; both ghats in daylight. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
ALP_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests

ALP_MANNAR.desc: Kerala's bell-metal town: watch Mannar's craftsmen cast urulis and lamps, then Chengannur's Mahadeva temple, the Pandava shrine of Thiruvanvandoor and the riverside church at Parumala.
ALP_MANNAR.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Temples first, before 11)
8:30 AM — Chengannur Mahadeva Temple: Shiva–Parvati temple famed for the goddess's Thriputharattu ritual. (Dress code · see below)
9:45 AM — Thiruvanvandoor Temple: Vishnu temple, one of the 108 Divya Desams, linked to the Pandavas. (Before 11)
11:00 AM — Mannar bell-metal forges: Watch craftsmen cast urulis, lamps and bells in family workshops. (Shops · buy direct)
12:30 PM — Parumala church: Tomb of St Gregorios of Parumala by the Pampa. Lunch in Mannar, own expense. (Modest dress)
3:30 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_MANNAR.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateways and ponds from outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
🔔 At the forges: These are working family workshops — sparks, molten metal and heat. Stay where the craftsman shows you and ask before photos. Buying is up to you: pay the shop direct. Heavy pieces can be packed for the boot.
⛪ Parumala: Shoulders and knees covered; quiet near the tomb and during prayers. The Parumala feast in early November and the Sabarimala season at Chengannur (mid-Nov to Jan) bring crowds — we adjust the order.
🚉 Pickups: Railway station first, then the KSRTC stand, then hotels in town — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the same places, or at your houseboat jetty.

ALP_MANNAR.exc: Lunch; Offerings and purchases; Tolls and parking (private trips)

ALP_MANNARASALA.desc: South into Onattukara: Mannarasala's serpent grove of thousands of snake idols, Haripad's ancient Murugan temple, Chettikulangara's great Devi shrine and the old granite Buddha of Mavelikara.
ALP_MANNARASALA.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: Alappuzha railway station · Alappuzha KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Temples first, before 11)
7:30 AM — Mannarasala Nagaraja Temple: Serpent shrine in a sacred grove, its paths lined with thousands of snake idols. (Dress code · see below)
9:00 AM — Haripad Subrahmanya Temple: Ancient temple of Murugan in Haripad town. Breakfast nearby, own expense. (Morning darshan)
10:30 AM — Chettikulangara Devi Temple: Onattukara's great Bhagavathy shrine, home of the Kumbha Bharani festival. (Before noon)
11:45 AM — Mavelikara Buddha: Granite Buddha found in the Achankovil river, at Buddha Junction. Lunch in Mavelikara, own expense. (Free · roadside)
2:30 PM — Drop-off: Alappuzha station, KSRTC bus station, your hotel or houseboat jetty
ALP_MANNARASALA.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateways, groves and ponds from outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
🐍 Mannarasala: The temple opens early and closes late morning, so it is our first stop. Stay on the paths in the grove and don't touch the idols. Ayilyam festival days bring huge crowds — on those dates we change the order or the day.
🔱 Festivals: Chettikulangara's Kumbha Bharani (Feb–Mar) brings towering decorated floats; on normal days the temple is calm. Ask us for festival dates — some are sold as private event trips.
🚉 Pickups: Railway station first, then the KSRTC stand, then hotels in town — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the same places, or at your houseboat jetty.

ALP_EV_ARTHUNKAL.desc: St Sebastian's great feast at Arthunkal's seaside basilica — Mass, candles and the statue carried to the beach and back. Your own vehicle, a driver who waits, a ride home. Event dates: Wed 20 Jan 2027 · main feast day (Feast 10–27 Jan — confirm the day's programme with the basilica).
ALP_EV_ARTHUNKAL.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, houseboat jetty, Alappuzha station, KSRTC stand or Cochin Airport.
9:00 AM — Drop near Arthunkal: 22 km up the coast road; we drop as close as the police allow. (Walk the last stretch)
Morning — Mass & the shrine: Holy Mass at St Andrew's Basilica and prayers at St Sebastian's statue. (Very crowded)
Midday — Lunch: Stalls around the church or hotels in Cherthala. (Own expense)
Afternoon — The feast procession: The statue is carried towards the beach and back, with bands and umbrellas. (Main moment)
7:00 PM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel, jetty or the station.
ALP_EV_ARTHUNKAL.gtk:
⛪ The feast: Arthunkal Perunnal honours St Sebastian at St Andrew's Basilica, a Portuguese-era church by the sea. Pilgrims of every faith come; many walk the last stretch or move on their knees from the beach as a vow.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Dates: The feast runs from the flag hoisting on 10 January to the octave on 27 January; 20 January (a Wednesday in 2027) is the main day. We confirm the procession time with the basilica before your trip.
🙏 Manners: Shoulders and knees covered; quiet during Mass. Keep children close on the beach and away from the water.

ALP_EV_CHAMPAKULAM.desc: The oldest snake-boat race of the season, on the Pampa at Champakulam in the heart of Kuttanad — rituals, a water procession, then chundan vallams racing for the Rajapramukhan Trophy. We drop you near the bank and bring you home. Event dates: ≈Sat 19 Jun 2027 · Moolam day (Estimate — confirm with the race committee).
ALP_EV_CHAMPAKULAM.itin:
10:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, houseboat jetty, Alappuzha station, KSRTC stand or Cochin Airport.
10:45 AM — Drop near Champakulam: About 17 km into Kuttanad. We drop where the police allow; walk to the riverbank. (Walk the last stretch)
Midday — Rituals & water procession: The day opens with temple rituals and decorated boats on the river. (Find a spot early)
Afternoon — Heats and the final: Snake boats and smaller classes race; the Rajapramukhan Trophy final closes the day. (Times on the day's schedule)
6:00 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop. Narrow dyke roads clear slowly. (Expect slow traffic)
7:00 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel, houseboat jetty or the station.
ALP_EV_CHAMPAKULAM.gtk:
🛶 The race: Champakulam Moolam opens Kerala's boat-race season, on the Moolam day of the month of Mithunam. It is tied to the Ambalappuzha Sri Krishna temple; snake boats, veppu and odi boats race on the Pampa.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: We expect the race on Saturday 19 June 2027 (Mithunam Moolam). The race committee fixes the day — we re-confirm before your trip.
☔ On the bank: Monsoon weather: carry an umbrella or raincoat; the banks get slippery. Keep children away from the water's edge; no one enters the river.

ALP_EV_NEHRUTROPHY.desc: Kerala's most famous snake-boat race on Punnamada lake — giant chundan vallams, a hundred oars each, boat songs and roaring galleries. We drop you near the venue and bring you home. Event dates: ≈Sat 14 Aug 2027 · Punnamada lake (Estimate — confirm with the NTBR Society).
ALP_EV_NEHRUTROPHY.itin:
9:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, houseboat jetty, Alappuzha station, KSRTC stand or Cochin Airport.
9:30 AM — Drop near Punnamada: Near Finishing Point, where the police allow; walk to your gallery. (Walk the last stretch)
Late morning — Heats of the smaller boats: Odi, veppu and iruttukuthi boats race first while the galleries fill. (Find your seat early)
Afternoon — Snake-boat heats & the final: Chundan vallams race in heats after the opening; the final ends the day. (Times on the day's schedule)
6:30 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop. Roads and jetties clear slowly after the race. (Expect slow traffic)
7:30 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel, houseboat jetty or the station.
ALP_EV_NEHRUTROPHY.gtk:
🛶 The race: Held on Punnamada lake at Alappuzha since 1952, after India's first Prime Minister watched the boats and gave the silver trophy. Chundan vallams — snake boats over 100 feet long — race in heats; smaller traditional boats race in their own classes.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: The race is held on a Saturday in August — we expect Saturday 14 August 2027. The Nehru Trophy Boat Race Society fixes the date — we re-confirm before your trip.
🎟️ Tickets: Gallery tickets are sold by the organisers before race day — buy yours in advance; we can help you find the booking link. Carry a cap, umbrella and water; galleries are open to sun and rain.
